reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 26. Nay or No: 5. Not Voting: 9. Of 31 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 31 (100%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 212 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
A proper warning can make all the difference in getting people out of harm’s way.

That’s why I’m proud to support the Fixing Gaps in Hurricane Preparedness Act, which will help ensure our communities receive stronger disaster warnings when they need them most. https://t.co/dHN6BMkaXV

Studies show that 89% of voters support my ASAP Act.

Congress has a clear message: early Alzheimer’s detection gives families more time and more options. With support across party lines, it’s time to move this bill across the finish line. https://t.co/aNoLQYhJij

Medicare open enrollment is here!

This annual opportunity lets Medicare recipients choose a plan that fits their needs, taking into account changes in costs, coverage, providers and pharmacies.

The enrollment period ends Dec. 7. https://t.co/ytnzABi3We

After a storm, Floridians deserve clear, consistent information about disaster aid, not mixed messages.

That’s why I’m cosponsoring the Disaster Loan Outreach Consistency Act. It requires the SBA to keep disaster loan materials accurate, up to date and consistent. https://t.co/mYaSAJpR1l

Every Floridian deserves clear, practical warnings and a plan they can count on.

Thank you to @mysuncoast for covering my support for the Fixing Gaps in Hurricane Preparedness Act. When a storm hits, no one in our community should be left behind. https://t.co/QrmKsw04bw

Unemployment just dropped to 4.1%.

As a business owner, I know what it takes to meet payroll, and what it takes to bring on new employees. Lower taxes and less red tape give job creators the confidence to grow. https://t.co/11Kp3uK6zM

Freedom has never been free.

Today we honor the men and women who answered the call, and the families who stood by them. To every veteran in Southwest Florida: thank you for your service. Our nation is grateful. https://t.co/HZNms2dLno

For 251 years, the brave men and women of the United States Marine Corps have answered the call to defend our nation with courage, discipline and honor.

We thank you and your family for your sacrifice and dedicated service. Semper Fi! https://t.co/7tNZchhdpy

The Hillsborough County Fair is happening right now!

One of my favorite parts of being your congressman is seeing our community come together to enjoy rides, delicious food, live entertainment, and family fun. The fair is open through November 15! https://t.co/2Z58bkux4b

Early detection can save lives.

That’s why it’s critical that the House passes my Alzheimer’s Screening and Prevention Act to allow Medicare coverage for blood screenings. The time to act is now, so let’s pass my bill ASAP. https://t.co/eth4ASPVHk

Economists expected 65,000 jobs in October. America delivered 165,000.

That’s the power of Washington cutting taxes and getting out of the way. I fought on @waysandmeansgop for the Working Families Tax Cuts to help employers hire, and I’m glad to see those results. https://t.co/f8q8vKMp7w

Please join Sandy and me in praying for the two Bradenton Police Department officers injured in the line of duty this morning, including one who remains in the ICU with a serious brain injury. https://t.co/dQXit1h79i

A hurricane warning can save lives when it reaches everyone.

Yet seniors, Floridians with disabilities, and rural families are left without the information they need. I’m proud to cosponsor the Fixing Gaps in Hurricane Preparedness Act, to help ensure no one is left behind. https://t.co/I7c9x3Vmtj

Congratulations to Bradenton’s own Nelly Korda on a remarkable career, including her first U.S. Women’s Open title this year. I was honored to help celebrate Nelly Korda Day by presenting her with a Congressional Record tribute and a flag flown over the U.S. Capitol. https://t.co/Cz4GxS2zpp

@POTUS is right. It’s time to lock the clock.

As this Congress comes to a close, I’ll keep working alongside my colleagues to pass the Sunshine Protection Act and make daylight saving time permanent once and for all. https://t.co/zL5AFKE6KW

Sandy and I are praying for the family and loved ones of the victim of today's shooting at the Citibank Center in Brandon.

We are deeply grateful to the Hillsborough County deputies and first responders who answered the call so quickly. https://t.co/e1yT1M6PEO

Our law enforcement works hard to keep our families, communities and livelihoods safe.

I’m truly grateful for their incredible courage and dedication to keep Florida families safe each and every day. It does not go unseen. https://t.co/WPuKlc3q1L

The science is clear: the earlier we spot Alzheimer’s, the more we can do to slow it.

My Alzheimer’s Screening and Prevention Act makes early detection part of preventive care so seniors get answers before it’s too late.

https://t.co/qbpK7c6qnl https://t.co/gm3c46xaXP

Heroes never clock out.

To every first responder: thank you for showing up when our community needs you most. This First Responders Week and every week, we’re grateful for all you do. https://t.co/Do7Vvka2Z9

Every crosswalk should be safe for everyone.

I’m proud to cosponsor the bipartisan Save Our Pedestrians Act, directing federal highway safety funding to improve the most hazardous crossings in our communities. https://t.co/vhS8wwGAxe

Darker evenings start this Sunday—but they don’t have to.

Permanent Daylight Saving Time means more sunshine after work and school, and more time outdoors with family. I’m working to make this the last time we change the clocks. It’s time to pass my Sunshine Protection Act. https://t.co/UEjbOCz6lV

I recently led a letter to the Senate urging the inclusion of my ten amendments in the final FY27 NDAA.

My amendments include provisions to combat obesity in the military, strengthen supply chains, counter foreign influence, and support servicemember health and safety. https://t.co/o5OzqWaZIX

Permanent daylight saving time would bring meaningful health, economic, and family benefits.

That’s why my bipartisan Sunshine Protection Act passed the House by a vote of 308-117. America is ready to lock the clock. https://t.co/YLHzQsJ69V

My wonderful wife Sandy and I are celebrating our 50th wedding anniversary this month, and we feel incredibly blessed.

After raising two sons, welcoming ten grandchildren, and sharing countless memories, I am forever thankful for the day we met in college. https://t.co/NAlIAKaRuc

America wants permanent daylight saving time.

As we approach the changing of the clocks, I’m proud to keep fighting for my Sunshine Protection Act, which will finally end the twice-yearly clock change for good. https://t.co/XFiibSyueq

Thanks to @POTUS for having me aboard Air Force One.

We had a good conversation about getting my top priorities done before year’s end, including the ASAP Act to improve early Alzheimer’s detection and the Sunshine Protection Act to make daylight saving time permanent. https://t.co/idl2rk84QV

Preventive care can make all the difference.

I’m proud of my ASAP Act with @RepPaulTonko, which ensures early access to Alzheimer’s screening to help families plan better and get help sooner. Now let’s get it passed through the House. https://t.co/GOtU1Lper2

America wants permanent daylight saving time.

My bipartisan Sunshine Protection Act passed the House to deliver that for our families, small businesses and our health. It’s time to lock the clock. https://t.co/E2sA80XDnC

Our team takes the world stage tonight!

The @RaysBaseball face the Milwaukee Brewers in Game 1 of the World Series, ready to bring home their first title. Let’s go, Rays! https://t.co/uuAiq8PS4F

19 states have already enacted legislation in support of permanent daylight saving time.

My Sunshine Protection Act will finally deliver Americans the results they voted for. It’s time to lock the clock. https://t.co/Domf8qwt3G

Small businesses are the backbone of our economy.

I’ve spent most of my life as a small business owner, and I know what it takes to turn an idea into jobs. Proud to join the bipartisan House Entrepreneurship Caucus to help more Floridians get their businesses off the ground. https://t.co/wAc3b6zpkA

In just a few weeks, we’ll change our clocks again. It’s time to put this outdated practice behind us for good.

My Sunshine Protection Act would make daylight saving time permanent, giving families more daylight to get outside and stay active. It's time to finally lock the https://t.co/my8pT909CI

The best medicine is often a daily workout.

That’s why I cosponsored the Fit Vets Act to give veterans free access to SilverSneakers and similar exercise programs, helping them stay mobile, prevent chronic disease and age well. https://t.co/mJzfJERhId

Please join Sandy and me in praying for the family and loved ones of the Manatee County Mosquito Control District pilot who lost his life last night in a helicopter crash in Myakka City. https://t.co/6hEkikFynO

Florida ranks 53rd out of 54 states and territories in Guardsmen per capita.

As a former Air National Guardsman, I know how important these men and women are. That’s why I joined a letter urging the Department of War to expand Florida’s National Guard to better meet our state’s needs.

Florida farmers grow some of the best food in America.

That’s why I’m proud to support the Local Foods for Healthy Schools Act, helping schools serve our children fresh, locally grown meals while supporting the farmers who grow the food right here at home. https://t.co/zvonPULjPK

Happy 251st birthday to the courageous sailors of the United States Navy! 🇺🇸

Since 1775, the @usnavy has stood watch and served with unwavering dedication to protect our nation. We’re grateful for their service and sacrifice. https://t.co/ZW4rlgaPE2

Early detection can make a life-changing difference for people with Alzheimer’s.

As Chairman of the @waysandmeansGOP Health Subcommittee, I’ll work alongside @RepPaulTonko to pass the ASAP Act and expand access to preventive screening. https://t.co/FK9tCojVZU

Twenty years ago, Southwest Florida trusted me to be their voice in Washington.

It’s been the honor of my life to fight for our families, small businesses and communities every single day. I look forward to finishing the fight strong. https://t.co/1JpxP80dti

Portugal is a founding NATO ally and one of America's oldest friends.

As Chairman of the @house_democracy, I was proud to host members of Portugal’s parliament to discuss expanding trade and investment between our two nations. Thank you for a great and productive conversation. https://t.co/bouS8iMORL

When it comes to Alzheimer’s, time matters. 

My bipartisan ASAP Act would give seniors access to simple blood tests that catch this disease early, giving families more time, more options and more hope. Read my op-ed in @thehill. 

https://t.co/AG2f0xRSQU https://t.co/guxUy2iwiT

Made in America is back, and stronger than ever.

Nearly 60,000 manufacturing jobs were added this year alone, and as Vice Chairman of @WaysandMeansGOP, I helped lead the Working Families Tax Cuts to make it easier to build here at home. https://t.co/69WdGsvnkT

1 in 8 American women will be diagnosed with breast cancer in their lifetime.

This Breast Cancer Awareness Month, I encourage every woman to talk with her doctor about screening. Early detection saves lives, and Sandy and I stand with every survivor, fighter and their families. https://t.co/tF1qd5xNCe

Children make up 25% of the population, but 100% of the future.

As Chairman of the @WaysandMeansGOP Health Subcommittee, I’m proud to cosponsor the Local Foods for Healthy Schools Act and the Know What’s on the Tray Act to help our kids grow up healthy and strong. https://t.co/0LTIN05NVA

A simple blood test could change everything for families facing Alzheimer’s.

As Chairman of the @WaysandMeansGOP Health Subcommittee, I introduced the bipartisan ASAP Act to expand Medicare coverage to catch Alzheimer’s early, a disease that affects over 7.2 million Americans. https://t.co/yHgDRGmXF3

Animal welfare and medical innovation can go hand in hand.

As co-chair of the Congressional Animal Protection Caucus, I’m proud to have introduced the FDA Modernization Act 2.0 to end outdated animal testing. Thank you to @SecKennedy and @HHSGov for putting it into action. https://t.co/yuHeAACuZX

More sun in the evenings means more time for our children, safer drives home and longer evenings together.

As Chairman of the @WaysandMeansGOP Health Subcommittee, I introduced the Sunshine Protection Act because permanent DST is a win for health and public safety. https://t.co/vQW8VtvBtJ

It’s time to lock the clock. 

My Sunshine Protection Act passed the House with strong bipartisan support. I’m working with @SenRickScott to send permanent DST to President Trump’s desk. My bill brings many economic, safety, family and health benefits to Americans nationwide. https://t.co/DeAVn1a0qI

Food security begins at home.

Over the past two decades, Florida’s share of the U.S. fruit and vegetable market has dropped nearly 50% while Mexico’s has surged more than 200%. I'm fighting for seasonal protections for our Florida growers in the USMCA review. https://t.co/2Csdqb07xP

The future of research doesn’t have to come at an animal’s expense.

As co-chair of the Congressional Animal Protection Caucus, I applaud @hhsgov for implementing my FDA Modernization Act 2.0, to reduce unnecessary animal testing and accelerate modern, human-based research. https://t.co/7uxs08001z

Today marks my last 100 days in Congress.

As the longest serving Southwest Florida member in the House, I have spent 20 years fighting for our veterans, our seniors and our families. Every day left will be spent doing the same as I finish strong. https://t.co/kWiRlouuQx

With 100 days left, my fight for Florida hasn’t changed.

I will continue to advocate for our communities and represent the people who sent me to Washington. There's still work to do, and I’m ready to make it happen. https://t.co/XaLp2UIm9s

The best cure for Alzheimer’s is catching it before it starts.

I'm honored, as Chairman of the @WaysandMeansGOP Health Subcommittee, to be named a Rural Health Champion by the National Grange for expanding access to Alzheimer’s diagnostics.
https://t.co/b6DBjxV4Vc https://t.co/zagNSWFREo

Early detection could save America up to seven trillion dollars.

That’s why I'm proud of my bipartisan ASAP Act, which advanced through @waysandmeansgop to expand Medicare coverage for early Alzheimer’s detection, giving families more time and hope.
https://t.co/inhEOfnqfA https://t.co/1L6cKwSYpU

What hurts American phosphate hurts the American farmer.

Sulfur prices are up nearly 600 percent, forcing fertilizer producers to cut jobs and production. That’s why I wrote a letter urging the Trump Administration to act now and protect our farmers.
https://t.co/lGszPffksO https://t.co/XEoIoYEdWr

Prevention today means better health tomorrow. 

That’s why I’m proud to support preventive care policies, like the ASAP Act, as Chairman of the @waysandmeansGOP Health Subcommittee. https://t.co/6tHj0L8jJV

Early detection gives families more time, options and hope. 

On World Alzheimer’s Day, I’m proud to share my ASAP Act advanced through @WaysandMeansGOP to expand coverage for early Alzheimer’s detection. https://t.co/pjfpbxmGA5

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
